rows.Origin:
Bred by Harkness & Co. (United Kingdom, before 2008).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2008 as 'Ryk Neethling'.
rows.Bloom: Cream - golden-yellow. Strong fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form.
